title: Hunts FH-009: Implement durable outbox and replay

source.ref: Frequency Hunts Build Plan (9 Nov 2026), Tier 0, Reliability. Owner asked 2026-11-09 to build the program into the site.

detail: Build leases, receipt keys, backoff, dead letters, bounded replay and admin audit. Done when: Kill worker after commit and after provider send, then replay with one semantic effect and no lost event. Requires: FH-006. Owner role: Platform.
